resources.string: Press the accessibility button or shortcut to start speak mode, then touch or drag across the screen to hear items. Press it again to stop. Normal touch input is paused only while speak mode is on.

Turn on the Speak on Touch accessibility service and assign it to the accessibility button or shortcut. The service does nothing by itself: press the button or shortcut to start speak mode, touch or drag across the screen to hear items, and press it again to stop.
Focus whole item, like TalkBack (e.g. read an entire chat row instead of just its name)
Stop speak mode when finger lifts
